basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer living in Manchester, UK. I've been a Doctor Who fan since I was a kid, and I love discussing episodes and theories on Reddit. When I'm not working or watching sci-fi, I enjoy motorcycle racing and investing in the stock market, which is why I frequent subs like '1000ccplus' and 'EducatedInvesting'. My typical online hours are in the evening after work, usually between 7 PM and 11 PM GMT. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore different hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over 5 years. My knowledge of Doctor Who comes from years of watching the series, reading related media, and engaging with fan communities online. I also self-taught myself investment strategies through online courses and forums.
